text:
maria_g: Quick heads-up — VerdantHealth asked for a pre-sales security deep-dive tomorrow AM. They want: KMS provisioning options (cloud KMS vs HSM), per-tenant RBAC mapping examples, and a short audit-log export/playbook for their auditors. Can we assemble a runnable checklist + evidence snippets?

aj: I can take KMS key lifecycle (creation, rotation, revocation) and a short HSM fallback description. Will draft a one-page flow diagram.

samir: I'll grab audit log retention policy details + how to produce a signed export for a tenant. Also can show SIEM ingest examples (CloudWatch -> S3 -> Splunk).

eli: I'll sketch RBAC role mappings for tenant isolation (service-account patterns + least-priv) and a sample Terraform snippet for provisioning service accounts.

maria_g: Thanks. @chris_v (Verdant) — are there any nonstandard compliance requests? e.g., longer retention, key escrow, or third-party access?

chris_v (Verdant): Hey all — thanks. Main asks: 1) show chain of custody for keys, 2) how we redact PII in logs before export, 3) can we produce an audit bundle within 48h for SOC2 readiness review?

aj: For chain of custody we can provide KMS access logs + key rotation history. If they need HSM attestation docs we have the HSM vendor MRA + attestation PDF.

samir: On redaction — we have two layers: (1) runtime scrubbing via prompt/payload filters, (2) post-collection redaction pipeline before export. Example redaction rule: replace email/ssn patterns + mask tokens in message text. Can show sample replacer config.

eli: 2 quick questions: do they require tenant-scoped service accounts (preferred) or per-team roles? also, what retention window do they want for raw logs vs. processed artifacts?

chris_v (Verdant): Tenant-scoped service accounts for sure. Retention: 7 years for processed audit artifacts (legal), 90 days for raw high-volume logs unless archived.

maria_g: OK. Action items: aj = KMS + attestation pack; samir = export playbook + redaction config + SIEM example; eli = RBAC mapping + TF snippet; I'll assemble the audit bundle template and run a dry export tonight.

sec-bot: SECURITY-CHECKLIST generated: [KMS_KEYS_PRESENT, AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_CONFIGURED, RBAC_LEAST_PRIVILEGE_VERIFIED, EXPORT_PLAYBOOK_EXISTS]. See https://internal.tools/checks/1778401234

aj: Draft KMS checklist note (short):
- Key creation: use customer-scoped DEK with envelope encryption (CEK encrypted by account KMS).
- Rotation: automated monthly rotation for CEKs, yearly for master keys (can be customer-controlled).
- Access logs: enable key access audit to cloud KMS and forward to audit bucket.
- HSM: optional on-prem HSM for customers who require FIPS/CSP. Provide attestation PDF and serial number ranges.

samir: Export playbook (short steps):
1) Run tenant log query: `redwood audit export --tenant verdanthealth --since 2025-01-01 --format jsonl --out /tmp/verdant-audit`
2) Run redaction: `audit-redactor --rules rules/verdant.json --in /tmp/verdant-audit --out /tmp/verdant-audit-redacted`
3) Sign bundle: `gpg --detach-sign -o /tmp/verdant-audit-redacted.sig /tmp/verdant-audit-redacted`
4) Upload to secure bucket with locked ACL and KMS-encrypted envelope key.

eli: Sample RBAC snippet (conceptual):
```
resource "redwood_service_account" "verdant_tenant" {
  name = "verdant-prod-sa"
  tenant = "verdanthealth"
  roles = ["inference:invoke", "logs:read:tenant"]
}
```
Note: map audit role to `logs:export` only for compliance engineers; operational roles limited to `inference:invoke` and `monitoring:read`

maria_g: Good. For evidence, we should include: KMS key history export (json), audit log sample (redacted + signature), RBAC role mapping doc, and our HSM attestation if requested. I'll create a ZIP template: `verdant-evidence-bundle.zip` with placeholders.

samir: One more vuln/incident note to prepare: how we handle a key compromise. Short incident runbook: revoke DEK, rotate master key, re-encrypt CEKs, notify tenant + rotate any active sessions, produce forensic log snapshot (immutable) and provide signed timeline. We'll include that in the bundle.

aj: Also include proof of no-plaintext-storage for customer data and an explanation of envelope encryption flow. A small diagram and the KMS policy snippet should cover that.

chris_v (Verdant): This looks great. Can you confirm you can produce the bundle within 24h? We need it for our security committee meeting.

maria_g: We'll prioritize. ETA: initial bundle by EOD today, final by tomorrow AM. I'll ping when the dry export is done.

eli: I'll push the TF snippet + RBAC policy to a temp repo and send a link.

samir: Starting a dry run now. If anyone sees a blocker, shout here.

maria_g: Nice. @sec-bot can you run the automated evidence lint on the folder when it's up?

sec-bot: LINT_RESULTS: evidence/verdant (pending). Will post results after upload.

aj: FYI — if Verdant requests KMS key escrow, we need legal sign-off. Tagging legal in the prep doc.

maria_g: Noted. I'll open a legal thread.

chris_v (Verdant): Thanks team — really appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria_g: Closing loop: dry export complete. Bundle link: https://internal.artifacts/verdant-evidence-1778401234.zip (contains README, signed audit, KMS history, RBAC mapping, incident-runbook). Please review before I hit send.

eli: Reviewed — minor wording tweaks on roles. Pushed updates.

samir: Ran lint: one redaction rule missing for ipv4 patterns, added. Re-running.

sec-bot: LINT_RESULTS: PASS (after ip rule fix). Timestamp 1778404899.

maria_g: Sending to Verdant in 10. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
